# Who carries the unfinished decision

An object awaiting inspection has an owner and a review date now. The uncertain tray is smaller, but some decisions still wait for Jo because no one else is authorized. The repair cafe can distribute tasks without distributing authority. [[Field methods]]: draw the decision route separately from the rota and see where both lead to one person.
